_meta_itemized.notes: A fully TYPED sheet with a faithful scanner OCR layer; both ledger pages were still read full-page at 200 dpi, and the expense row was re-read on a 900 dpi tight crop as the geometry spot-check (reproduced '3/12/18 | Summit County Clerk | Auditor Filing Fee | $587.08'). NO template specimen rows on this filing - the filer used a clean form, and the single real row on each page is HIGHLIGHTED YELLOW by the filer or the clerk. THE WHOLE CAMPAIGN IS ONE SELF-FUNDING TRANSACTION: the candidate contributed $587.08 to himself on 3/12/18 and spent exactly that on the Auditor filing fee the same day, closing to a zero balance. Privacy: the Mailing Address column carries a street address; only city/state are retained. The split50 <=$50 box is BLANK on the page (not a written zero), which under the zero-glyph ruling is a blank, not a numeral - the cover cache's $0.00 for that line is the cover's own figure, not this page's.
